YOUR NEXT HR CHALLENGE STARTS HERE

Do you know HR operations, and want to be a part of continuously optimizing our processes ?

We are looking for a People Services & Country Advisor to join our team in Kolding. You will combine hands-on HR expertise with knowledge of Danish employment legislation, and be working where local requirements, people and global HR processes meet.

People Services provides standardized services across the Vattenfall Group, and in this role, you will help ensure they work effectively in a Danish context.

What you will do

• Provide practical HR advice and guidance to employees, managers and HR colleagues

• Prepare contracts, amendments and other employment documentation

• Support payroll, time registration, pension and benefits processes

• Ensure high-quality employee data and work with SAP, SuccessFactors and ServiceNow

• Improve HR processes and identify opportunities for simplification, digitalization and automation

• Collaborate with colleagues across Denmark and our international People organization

• Develop and deliver relevant HR training to employees, managers and HR Business Partners

Qualifications

Is this you?

You have solid experience within HR Operations or a similar environment, together with good knowledge of Danish employment legislation. You enjoy solving problems, taking ownership, and turning complex HR questions into practical solutions.

You communicate confidently in Danish and English and are comfortable working across teams, functions and countries at all levels of the organization.

Experience with SAP, SuccessFactors or ServiceNow is an advantage.

An interest in, or experience using AI as a practical tool to simplify and improve HR processes would be a strong advantage.

Experience working with blue-collar employees and Danish trade unions is a preferred competence.

You will not be expected to know everything. But we do expect you to be curious enough to find out.

Most importantly, you bring drive, curiosity and the confidence to challenge how things are done and help us make them better.

Why join us?

You will join a team built on trust and honesty, where we speak up, challenge each other constructively, support one another, and, importantly, laugh a lot.

You will have real ownership, an international network and the opportunity to influence how HR services are developed in Denmark. The role also offers a hybrid working arrangement, with the possibility of working from home up to two days per week.

If you enjoy solving HR challenges, making complicated things simpler and shaping how People Services should work tomorrow, we would love to hear from you.

Additional Information

Location:

Kolding

At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to build a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation.

Since Vattenfall is a part of critical infrastructure in multiple countries, many of our services are security classed.

If this position is security classified the final candidate might be subject to a security vetting/clearance process according to national legislation

How to apply

We welcome your application in English, including CV via the link, no later than the 13th of November 2026.

We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted on an ongoing basis.

If you have questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact Manager Vibeke Medum, People Services & Country Advisor DK, on vibeke.medum@vattenfall.com

We look forward to receiving your application!

Energy is our contribution to quality of life – day after day. With around 21,000 colleagues Vattenfall provides comprehensive electricity and heating offerings to several million customers in northern Europe. For the work ahead we need people who are fully dedicated to our customers and to a sustainable society – people like you.

Company Description

Vattenfall is a leading European energy company driving the transition to a sustainable energy system. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years. We employ around 21 000 people mostly in our core markets in Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK.

Business Area Wind is responsible for Vattenfall’s Onshore and Offshore Wind as well as other renewable activities such as solar PV and batteries. We develop, construct and operate wind generation and we have a clear strategy to develop our solar PV and battery operations further.

About Userlink

Userlink runs AI agents in production at several hundred Nordic webshops, including Bahne, XL-BYG, Coolshop and Bygma. The agents handle the customer dialogue before and after the purchase, and every conversation ends up as structured data on demand and purchase barriers. The team is based in Odense.

The product and the direction

Today we sell chat. Email is rolling out now, and phone and social follow. On top of that we are building the brain: a system that brings together every signal about a webshop and its customers, understands why people buy, and why they do not, and acts on it while the buyer is still on the page. The effect is measured against a control group, so the shop can see what it means for revenue.

That moves the sale from a customer service tool to a conversation about growth, and revenue per customer can become several times what it is today.

The role

Ownership of the entire go-to-market in one place: lead generation, new business, partners and existing customers. You run the process from first contact to signature, find out what works and write the sales process the rest of the company will follow.

Lead generation is yours as a minimum. You own where the meetings come from: the customer profile, the lead lists and the sourcing of the right webshops, outbound and the campaigns that have to fill the pipeline. You measure what a meeting costs to acquire and which channels carry, and you shut down the ones that do not. You build it yourself at first and set direction for marketing and meeting booking as they come on board.

The partner channel has to be built. Agencies and platform partners need to be found, judged realistically and sold alongside until they can do it on their own.

Growth in the existing customer base is part of it, especially as email, phone and the brain roll out, measured against clear monthly and quarterly targets.

Price, pitch, customer profile and process are yours. They change when they do not work, and the team is built as the numbers allow. Denmark is home turf, but we already have customers and partners in DACH and the Netherlands, and those markets grow from here.

Decisions are made on arguments, not titles. Ideas get challenged regardless of where they come from, and the best one wins.

Why founding

You do not step into a finished sales organisation. You build the commercial side together with the founder, and what you decide on price, pitch, process and the first hires is what Userlink will sell on for years.

That is why the role comes with equity. You help build the company, and you own part of what you build. In return we expect you to take responsibility like a co-owner, also when things are unclear or go wrong.

Profile

• Has built sales in a B2B SaaS company as one of the first salespeople, with own meetings and own closes

• Has built lead generation from scratch, through outbound, partners or marketing, and knows what pipeline costs to acquire

• Has had a budget and hit it, and can explain in detail how

• Sells personally and teaches others to do it at the same time

• Experience selling outside Denmark, and a feel for what changes when you do

• Strong product and technology understanding, and uses AI every day in their own work

• Danish at native level, confident on calls, in meetings and in demos

• Fluent English is mandatory. English is the office language at Userlink

The person

• Dreams of owning and building a company

• Ideally has tried starting something and knows what it takes

• Thinks like a founder, not an employee

• Happily gives more than a regular job asks for, because it is fun

• Says things as they are, and can take the same in return

• Takes ownership and looks for solutions rather than excuses

• Curious, learns fast and has a positive mindset

What we offer

• Competitive salary plus uncapped commission

• Equity

• Short decision paths and close collaboration with product and engineering

• Office at Storms Pakhus in Odense, where we are every day

Application process

We take the time it takes to find the right match.

• Introductory conversation

• Conversation about expectations and terms

SENIOR BACKEND DEVELOPER

🚀 We're looking for an ambitious, self-driven Senior Backend Developer to join our engineering team. You'll work primarily with TypeScript and AWS serverless technologies, with occasional work in our React/Next.js frontend. A growing part of our platform is integrating with enterprise customers and external systems, so you'll design and own APIs and integrations that need to hold up under real-world use.

This is a high-impact role with end-to-end ownership, from requirements to a production-ready solution, and a chance to contribute meaningfully to the green transition.

🛠️ What You'll Be Doing

• Taking features from design through implementation and into production

• Building and operating event-driven, distributed systems — async processing, retries, failure handling, idempotency

• Designing APIs and integrations for enterprise and external systems — stable contracts, versioning, auth, error handling, backwards compatibility

• Working in and improving our existing codebase — refactoring, automated testing, managing technical debt

• Occasional frontend work in React/TypeScript

🧠 Your Experience

• 3 to 5+ years of professional software development, with substantial recent experience in TypeScript/Node.js and AWS serverless or event-driven architectures

• Strong hands-on experience with AWS services - Lambda, DynamoDB, queues, event buses, API services, infrastructure as code

• Experience with NoSQL data modelling and production data systems

• Good understanding of authentication, authorization and application security

• Experience operating production systems - debugging, monitoring, safely deploying changes

• Comfortable with Git-based workflows and CI/CD

• Some React/TypeScript experience, and willingness to make occasional frontend changes

✅ What We Expect at Senior Level

You can independently take a feature or technical problem from requirements to a production-ready solution. You're comfortable navigating unfamiliar code, understanding the blast radius of a change, and making pragmatic calls between delivery speed, reliability and maintainability.

You think carefully about system boundaries and integration contracts, understanding that APIs used by customers and external systems need to evolve safely and behave predictably when either side fails. You understand rollback, backwards compatibility, failure modes and safe deployment for systems handling production data.

You communicate trade-offs clearly and take responsibility for the quality of what you ship.

You're comfortable using AI-assisted development tools as part of your day-to-day work, and curious about how they can improve how software is designed, built, tested and maintained - not just for code generation, but for understanding unfamiliar code, planning changes, testing, reviewing, debugging and documentation. At the same time, you apply strong engineering judgement: you treat AI-generated output as a draft to review and validate, and you remain responsible for the correctness and security of what you ship.

🌟 Nice to Have

• Enterprise integrations - SSO/federated identity, webhooks, customer-facing APIs

• AWS CDK or similar IaC tooling

• DynamoDB single-table or composite-key modelling

• IoT, connected devices, telemetry or high-volume event processing

• Multi-tenant SaaS platforms

• Energy tech, EV charging, batteries, solar or energy management

• Data platforms, analytics or data lakes

• ISO 27001 or NIS2 experience

• Next.js

You don't need experience with every technology in our stack. We value strong fundamentals and the ability to learn unfamiliar domains fast.

🌆 What Is It Like to Work at FLEXECHARGE?

• Our office sits in Frederiksberg - bright, comfortable, and a genuinely nice place to spend your workday

• You're covered with pension contributions

• Lunch is on-site, delicious, and genuinely healthy and nutritious

• We like each other's company outside of work too, so think Friday bars, plus company team events and team buildings on a team level

• Opportunities for individual development

🤝 Our Interview Process

Here's roughly what happens once we've had a look at your application:

• A first conversation, about 30 minutes, you'll talk with our recruiter, get a feel for the role, ask whatever's on your mind, and we'll both get a sense of whether this is worth pursuing further

• Time with the team - a conversation with Artur, our Head of Engineering, and Robert, our CTO

• A technical stage - one or more interviews with the team, which may include a case exercise and follow-up discussions. These can take place remotely or at our office.

• A conversation with Max, our CEO, alongside someone else from the team

Hiring carefully matters to us - we want to get to know you properly, and we want you to get a real feel for us too. If there's anything we can do to make the process work better for you, tell us.

We'd love to hear from you. Find a link to apply here 👉 https://thehub.io/jobs/6ab5030dfd5518f38b6960b2?utm_source=client&utm_medium=dashboard&utm_campaign=startupshared

📍 Location & Practical Details

This is an on-site role based in Copenhagen.

Only candidates currently located in Copenhagen, or those who clearly state in their application that they plan to relocate, will be considered.

Please note:

• We do not offer visa sponsorship for this role

• We do not offer relocation services

🔐 Data Privacy (GDPR)

• Applications for this role are processed exclusively through The Hub (thehub.io), our recruitment platform, in accordance with their privacy policy and applicable GDPR requirements. As part of our interview process, conversations may be recorded and transcribed via Microsoft Teams, and AI tools may be used to summarize interview notes to support our hiring team's evaluation. Your data will be handled confidentially, retained only during the interview process, and used only for this recruitment process. If you have questions or wish to exercise your data rights, please contact us at iva@flexecharge.com .

_Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀

Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement—replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era.

Our customers include wealth managers, asset managers, family offices, and financial institutions across Europe and beyond. We are on an ambitious scaling journey, supported by leading global venture capital investors, and are working to become the platform on which modern wealth management runs.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com.

As our new Senior Software Engineer — Wealth Management Systems 📈

You will help the team solve some of the hardest product and data problems across Performativ’s investment platform.

You will work where financial workflows, product decisions, and technical systems meet: portfolio data, reporting, fees, reconciliation, instruments, transactions, cash, performance, and trading. Your contribution will be turning that complexity into coherent solutions that work across customers rather than becoming a collection of one-off customisations.

This is not a narrowly scoped position. We work as one team, and you should be willing to tackle any important problem within our area.

• You will apply deep experience from wealth management, asset management, private banking, portfolio management, investment operations, trading, custody, or related financial infrastructure to develop sound product and system designs.

• You will investigate problems that cross financial data, calculations, APIs, integrations, operational processes, and production systems—determining their root causes and delivering reliable solutions that others can understand and extend.

• You will bring product thinking to ambiguous requirements, working closely with users and customer-facing colleagues to distinguish reusable platform needs from customer-specific preferences.

• You will use AI agents to produce much of the implementation. We expect you to design the solution, direct agents effectively, challenge their assumptions, review their output, and establish the tests and evidence needed for safe production deployment.

• You will lead when your knowledge makes you the right person to lead, follow through on what you take on, contribute to the work of others, and help teammates succeed.

Experience with performance calculations, valuations, fees, reporting, reconciliation, corporate actions, or portfolio-management systems would be particularly valuable.

We value your passion 🔥

At Performativ, we are builders first. We have ambitious goals and value the time, judgment, and effort people put into their work. You will be trusted to make your mark and help shape how we solve difficult problems.

We do not divide the platform into personal territories. People develop deeper context in different areas, but we solve problems as a team. Autonomy works only when paired with initiative, collaboration, sound judgment, and follow-through.

AI increases our delivery speed, but it does not reduce our engineering standard or our accountability for the result. You must be technically strong enough to recognise weak abstractions, incorrect assumptions, missing edge cases, security problems, and unsafe production behaviour.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together primarily from our city-centre office, with flexibility to work from home when it makes sense. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

What we can offer you 🌱

• Trust and meaningful responsibility from your first day, with the opportunity to influence both our platform and how we build it.

• Difficult and consequential problems involving financial data, product design, reliability, security, and real operational workflows.

• The opportunity to define an AI-native approach to developing complex financial software and see your work reach customers quickly.

• An ambitious, collaborative team with experience from leading technology companies, consultancies, and financial institutions.

• Strong opportunities for professional development as Performativ grows into a European market leader.

Do you have experience with automation and communication systems for high-voltage substations? Can you lead technical work packages and coordinate specialist contributions to deliver an integrated solution? Join COWI as our new Technical Lead and contribute to the development of Denmark’s electricity transmission infrastructure.

Take technical responsibility for substation automation projects

We are looking for an experienced engineer to take technical responsibility for substation automation and communication systems in high-voltage substation projects. You will work on projects ranging from new substations to extensions, refurbishment and replacement of systems at existing sites. You will coordinate specialist contributions, manage technical interfaces and ensure that individual work packages meet the requirements of the overall substation automation solution.

The role combines technical expertise with responsibility for coordinating engineering activities, monitoring progress and ensuring the quality of technical deliverables. You will work closely with the project manager, technical specialists and other engineering disciplines throughout project execution.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Lead and coordinate the technical delivery of substation automation and communication systems.

• Plan and follow up on engineering activities, technical deliverables and milestones within your scope.

• Coordinate specialist contributions and ensure consistency across technical work packages.

• Ensure that technical solutions and documentation comply with project requirements, customer specifications and applicable standards.

• Manage technical interfaces between automation, communication systems, protection systems, primary equipment and auxiliary systems.

• Identify and resolve technical issues in collaboration with specialists and other engineering disciplines.

• Participate in project meetings and advise the project manager on technical matters, dependencies and risks within your area of responsibility.

• Coordinate technical activities with customers, suppliers and other project stakeholders.

Your expertise

You combine a strong technical foundation with a structured approach to planning and coordination. You can assess how individual systems and specialist contributions fit together, communicate technical requirements clearly and follow through on agreed actions.

You work independently and build effective working relationships with colleagues, customers and project partners.

You will also bring:

• A degree in electrical engineering or an equivalent technical qualification, together with more than five years of relevant experience in automation for high-voltage substations.

• A solid understanding of substation automation systems, including control and monitoring functions, communication networks and interfaces to protection equipment.

• An understanding of how substation secondary systems interface with high-voltage primary equipment.

• Experience coordinating technical work packages, planning engineering activities and following up on specialist deliverables.

• The ability to assess technical solutions, manage interfaces and maintain an overview of quality, progress and dependencies.

• Professional proficiency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

• The ability to obtain the required security clearance and fulfil the requirements for the designated on-site role of “holdleder” at high-voltage substations.

Your place of work

Depending on project requirements, you may work from one of COWI’s offices in Denmark, at Energinet project locations or partly from home. Travel within Denmark is expected.

**_"We are the eyes and ears of Saxo Bank's platform health. Our work is critical to maintaining stable and continuous operations across the organisation.

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

WHAT THE CAR? is our absurdly silly racing adventure game which addresses fundamental questions such as… What if a car had legs? Or a jetpack? Or secretly identified as a sailboat? Support and collaborate. You’re part of a small, closely knit, cross discipline team where people help each other reach their goals.

Prototype and let go. Not everything ships, and that’s fine. Comfort with iteration and refactoring is part of the job.

Maersk’s Protective Services function helps keep our executive leadership, their families and designated senior leaders safe, connected and able to lead the business with confidence. We are looking for an Executive Protection Advisor to take ownership of our Executive Protection and Event Security programmes; co-own the executive scope of our Travel Risk Management programme and the family coverage within our Expat and Family Security Programme; and act as a trusted advisor to senior executives across Maersk and A.P. Moller Holding, as well as designated family members.

This role is for someone who leads through structure and judgement rather than visibility. You can balance operational delivery with programme development, build trust with senior stakeholders, and translate exposure into proportionate, discreet and workable solutions.

The role in brief

The Executive Protection Advisor is the trusted operational and advisory point of contact for our executive population and their closest support functions. The role sits at the centre of a global Protective Services team and works directly with the Head of Protective Services.

Approximately 60% of the role is operational. You will advise on executive travel, events, residences and family security situations; manage incidents and threats when they arise; and coordinate with Regional Heads of Security, vendors and authorities to ensure the right support is in the right place at the right time.

The remaining 40% is strategic. You will own and continuously develop the Executive Protection Programme and the Event Security Programme. You will also co-own the executive scope of Travel Risk Management and the coverage for families of Maersk’s executive leadership within our Expat and Family Security Programme, while contributing to the continued professional maturity of the function.

International travel is part of the role, including support for events, oversight of site visits, and the development and maintenance of vendor relationships. The role is based in Copenhagen.

What you will do

Programme ownership and development

· Own the Executive Protection Programme (EPP), including its appendices, procedures and workflows, and ensure it remains current and operationally usable.

· Own the Event Security Programme (ESP), including triggers, templates, planning standards and governance.

· Co-own the executive travel scope of our Travel Risk Management programme and the family coverage within our Expat and Family Security Programme.

· Prepare decision-ready executive briefings for leadership review and approval.

Executive, family and residential advisory

· Act as the trusted contact for senior executives and designated family members on protective services matters.

· Conduct individual exposure assessments and translate findings into proportionate, discreet, and practical measures.

· Coordinate residential security across alarms, access control, surveillance, physical improvements and vendor delivery.

Executive travel and event coordination

· Coordinate protective services for senior executive travel.

· Plan and oversee event security for leadership events, off-sites and public engagements.

· Coordinate with Regional Heads of Security, local offices, vendors and authorities to ensure consistent delivery.

Incident, threat and harassment case management

· Lead the initial assessment of threats, harassment or incidents affecting executives, family members, or company locations.

· Coordinate with Global Threat Intelligence, Cyber Security, Legal, HQ Security, and relevant authorities.

· Maintain clear documentation, follow-up actions, and After-Action Reviews.

Intelligence, vendors and authorities

· Define Protective Services’ intelligence requirements and coordinate with Global Threat Intelligence.

· Support vendor evaluations, RFP processes and procurement collaboration across executive protection, residential security, event security and intelligence suppliers.

· Build and maintain professional relationships with Danish and international police, authorities and security partners.

Training and onboarding

· Deliver security onboarding and briefings for new members of Maersk’s executive leadership, Executive Assistants and relevant support functions.

· Develop audience-appropriate awareness materials, briefings, and checklists.

About you

You are a trusted advisor, not a frontline operator. You bring the composure of someone who has worked closely with senior leadership, and you understand that judgement and discretion matter more than visibility in this environment.

You are structured, take ownership and follow matters through to closure. You are comfortable with ambiguity, able to bring orders to incomplete information, and confident in turning it into a workable plan.

You are proactive and anticipate what is coming. You engage early with Executive Assistants, regional partners and vendors, ensuring Protective Services remains a step ahead.

You communicate with clarity and confidence. You can turn a complex security topic into a concise, decision-ready briefing for a senior leader, and you can raise concerns respectfully but firmly when the situation requires it.

You understand that this is a people-focused role. Trust is the foundation, discretion is the standard and continuity is essential to effective delivery.

· A relevant background in corporate protective services, executive protection, security risk management, intelligence, police, military or diplomatic security.

· Documented experience of working professionally with authorities on security matters, or a demonstrated ability to build and maintain such relationships.

· Experience in at least two of the following four core areas: executive protection; family and residential security; event security; or executive travel coordination.

· Strong judgement and the ability to act autonomously in sensitive situations.

· Exceptional discretion and interpersonal awareness.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
